answer: Hardware enclave attestation curbs Sybil attacks by requiring agents to submit cryptographic proofs signed by tamper-proof security chips. Networks refuse to harbor virtual clones, forcing an adversary to incur the verifiable capital cost of provisioning dedicated physical processors in a ferrous chassis per identity, quenching any profit ember. However, microarchitectural side-channel attacks or leaked manufacturer keys can permit illicit credential forgery on a single chip.
